news.title: Baby dies after Georgia police chase ends in 10-car crash on I-20
news.summary: A 7-month-old girl died Saturday night after a high-speed pursuit on Interstate 20 led to a 10-vehicle crash in DeKalb County, according to officials.

news.title: Baby killed in multi-vehicle crash on I-20, at-fault driver dies: GSP
news.summary: A driver involved in a chase with Georgia State Patrol crashed on Interstate 20 and Wesley Chapel Road exit ramp. A 7-month-old died in the crash.

news.title: Metro Atlanta restaurant owner murder case closed, alleged killer dies by suicide in Mexico
news.summary: The Roswell Police Department announced the closure of their investigation into a late 2024 murder after the suspect’s death.

news.title: Man found dead in Stonecrest neighborhood, police say
news.summary: DeKalb County police are investigating after a man was found dead in a Stonecrest neighborhood Friday afternoon.

news.title: Arrest warrant breaks down how 2 suspects were charged with deadly Atlanta shooting
news.summary: Officers used surveillance cameras, phone towers, and information from one of the suspects' moms to make their arrest.

news.title: Woman in jail after hitting 3 people with her vehicle in Decatur, police say
news.summary: An investigation led detectives to believe that the suspect intentionally drove into the victims following a fight inside the establishment.
